next.reason: 1985: 'REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ END-REWRITE ]'; 2023: 'REWRITE { record-name-1 RECORD | FILE file-name-1 } [ FROM { identifier-1 | literal-1 } ] [ retry-phrase ] [ WITH LOCK | WITH NO LOCK ]'. Every 1985 form remains valid, but 2023 adds cases: FILE file-name-1, FROM literal-1, the RETRY phrase and the LOCK phrases. More programs are accepted.
